findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#mbb" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 18.58s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Full-frame overlay "#leak0-i" starts visible before its first GSAP opacity tween at 31.82s. It will cover earlier render frames, often as a blank/white video.
findings.fixHint: Add `opacity: 0` to "#leak0-i" in CSS/inline styles, or add an immediate `gsap.set("#leak0-i", { opacity: 0 })` (outside the timeline) before the reveal tween.

findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#e21-s0-dg-ph" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.
